voiceScript: Ask most small business owners if their marketing is working and you get a shrug. Get more customers was never something you could check in a week. So I turn it into one number with a deadline. Forty qualified leads by the end of Q1. Then I break that number into a weekly target. Forty over twelve weeks is three to four leads a week, checked every Monday. Then I name the metric that actually predicts revenue, not the one that is easiest to screenshot. A goal you check in twelve weeks is a wish. A goal you check every Monday is a system. Follow for more.
